scope: Actual 3.9 and local unpublished 3.10 source-generated records are immutably viewed and explicitly migrated for current-model numerical recomputation; the old solvers are not executed by the current application.

verticalAccelerationMps2.meaning: Historical E/Q acceleration envelope; not the stronger new-session default.

migration.defaultStateMeaning: No default physical or controller state was added. Full historical state and collision signature must match the current contract.
migration.preserved: All existing historical parameters (including climbRateMps and manual rate limits), rigid body, wheels, gas, valves, controller state, disturbance phase, observation buffers and seed.
migration.limitation: The 3.9.0 solver is not executed. The current model recalculates the explicitly mapped initial state; this is never an exact old-model replay.
